source:
Anisetta’s debut game is based off Arthurian legend. In a period of chaos and war, the throne is vacated with the death of the previous king. Arthur becomes the new king and is attacked by the 11 surrounding countries, but he fights them off and instead is viewed as the king of all countries. With peace finally in hand, the magician Merlin tells him to marry a princess from a neighbouring country. Even though he had taken her advice many times, he refuses to do so this time. She believes that it is necessary to strengthen the newly-found peace and that he is just afraid because he’s not used to being with girls. Don’t worry, she has a plan and the Knights of the Round Table will gladly help out.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Anisetta的出道作取材自亚瑟王传说。在一个战乱纷飞的时代，先王驾崩，王位空悬。亚瑟成为新王，并遭到周边11个国家的进攻；他不仅击退敌军，还被尊为所有国家的共主。和平终于到来，魔法师梅林劝他迎娶邻国公主。尽管他过去多次采纳她的建议，这次却一口回绝。梅林认为，联姻对巩固来之不易的和平至关重要，而亚瑟只是因为不习惯与女性相处才心生畏惧。不必担心，她已经有了计划，圆桌骑士们也很乐意帮忙。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
